title: DISTANCE-TO-FINAL LEDGER CONSOLIDATED + 0147 OFFSET BAND CLOSED: the in-tree endpoint (post-0111, post-0142/0148) has EXACTLY THREE named open items toward RH — (1) the residual face hOffG on (H, inf) x (0, 0.3748087], the TRACKER-TAIL item, shrinking by the demonstrated conveyor to d0 <= 0.3747729897 on PR#69 merge (pre-staged, replay green); (2) G-hs1, the SCALE ANTI-DEGENERACY gap (kernel-scale LOWER bound at a hypothetical off-line zero; the body carries kernel UPPER bounds and detector LOWER bounds only — different objects; measured shadow = the S1Marg margin track, 25 certified candidates >= 1 class to 2.8e7, exploratory signal below 1 from 3.1e7); (3) G-hs3, the T4 OFF-LINE LIFT gap (the p8_B T4 wire is a critical-line bound at Re s = 1/2; off-pair zeros are off the line by definition; the tree has no kernel upper bound at off-line points; the P3 mass pin is a premise by design) — and the 0147 offset band is CLOSED BY PROVENANCE: her Bernstein certificate layer is FROZEN TENSOR TABLES evaluated at her c (301 rows x 3x4 rational tensors, identity by norm_num;ring, positivity by bsum_pos with m > 0 and g_ij >= 0), and the positive-expansion SEARCH that produced them is external AI-assisted work (her own header: 'Adapted from liqsweep / A48 (AI-assisted), PR52, blueberryvertigo/QuasiRiemannTracker commit cbb3e1fa... submissions/count-affine-plain-20261014/src/Candidate/CountAffine/Bern.lean') — no generator ships in the public tree, so the [0.874561, 0.874773) band is claimable only by re-running that search (her pipeline). Lineage finding for the frontier map: Collet's record inherits its certificate technology from the PR#52 / count-affine line (the weaker WIP PR we audited in 0136/0146) — the AI-assisted certificate-search class is now the dominant tool on the race. NEXT FORWARD LINE (started): aim that tool class directly at the in-tree face — extract the polynomial comparison kernel of the face squeeze (devProg/floProg/p8_B/MrLift worst point at t = 1000, d0 = 1/200, ratio 1.1136) and search for a positive Bernstein expansion, which would close part of the face IN BODY beyond the conveyor's reach; verdict pending. No in-tree change this unit, no RH claim.
body:
## The three named open items (exact, current state)

1. RESIDUAL FACE hOffG: (t0 >= H = 1000, 0 < d0 <= gaoD0max = 0.3748087; on the record footing t0 >= tPT2 = 3,000,175,332,800). The squeeze certificate covers the face fully (face minimum d0 = 1/200 edge, measured margin ratio >= 1.1136 — the squeeze does not reach the small-d0 edge; the edge position is FRONTIER-driven, not T4-driven). Conveyor: 0148 replay green, pre-staged; on merge -> hOffC (d0 <= 0.3747729897), shrink 3.571e-5.

2. G-hs1 (SCALE ANTI-DEGENERACY): a LOWER bound, at the scale of a hypothetical off-line zero, on the kernel (W_n / mass-gap side). 0111: 'body has kernel UPPER bounds and detector LOWER bounds only... those lower bounds live on the DETECTOR (p8_far_detector_mag_ge_two, strideU_floor), a different object.' Measured shadow: the S1Marg margin track — 25 certified candidates, margin >= 1 in class up to 2.8e7; the first exploratory dip below 1 at 3.1e7. An in-tree closure would need either (a) a kernel-scale lower bound (new analytic input class) or (b) a data campaign that extends the margin track's certified range past the dip with a structural reason (not just more data).

3. G-hs3 (T4 OFF-LINE LIFT): p8_B (p4_T4_bound) is a CRITICAL-LINE bound (Re s = 1/2). An off-pair zero is off the line by definition (that is what d0 > 0 means). The tree carries no kernel upper bound at off-line points, and the P3 mass pin is a premise by design. The in-tree attack line is the T4OffL square-root schedule family (0125-0129, S8 port green, left-tuned): its pre-check at t = 1000, d0 = 1/200 has ratio devProg/(p8_B + MrLift) >= 1.1136 — the squeeze BUDGET is exceeded by ~11% at the face's worst point, which is exactly why the face's small-d0 edge is open and frontier-driven. A closure needs the same class of object the tracker race is producing: a POSITIVE certificate of the margin polynomial on a box (the Bernstein tool class), or a sharper off-line kernel bound (new analytic input).

## 0147 offset band — closed by provenance (this unit)

Investigated whether the generated certificate layer of her final stage is regenerable from her public tree at a deeper c (which would make the 2.116311e-4 band claimable by any party). Answer: NO — and the lineage is a frontier-map finding in itself.

- The final stage's certificate rows (Record1252270103Finite/ReturnNNN.lean, 301 rows) each PROVE an identity rowMargin .edge .class δ p = bsum 2 3 m g (a,b) (c,e) δ p at her frozen constants, by `norm_num [.., c, h, theta, ell, x, y, kappa, ..]; ring`, then positivity by bsum_pos (0 < m by norm_num; 0 <= g_ij by norm_num over fin_cases). m and the 3x4 tensor g are FROZEN RATIONALS (e.g. row010 m = 2164694249054943993772365638175668612267/14497809446028584763033182208000000000000, box [111/256, 57/128] x [63/128, 1/2]) — evaluated at her c = 1252270103/10^10, not parameterized in c. A deeper c changes rowMargin's rational expansion, hence every table, hence the whole 301-row + bootstrap + intermediate layer must be regenerated.
- The Bernstein FRAMEWORK itself (Record12518109/Bernstein.lean, 44 lines: bterm/bsum/bterm_nonneg/bsum_pos) is generic and shared, but it is a CONSUMER, not a generator.
- The GENERATING step is external, AI-assisted, and not shipped: her own header in that file: 'Adapted from liqsweep / A48 (AI-assisted), PR52, blueberryvertigo/QuasiRiemannTracker commit cbb3e1faac3f4dd711b06628a6b0052d388f12a5, submissions/count-affine-plain-20261014/src/Candidate/CountAffine/Bern.lean'. So the [0.874561, 0.874773) band of 0147 is claimable only by whoever re-runs the positive-expansion search — her pipeline (or a reproduction of it). The 0147 verdict stands as final: no leapfrog of her claim is available from our side; the band is PENDING NEXT-CYCLE material for the race.
- LIFETIME NOTE for the frontier map: the certificate technology of the CURRENT TOP candidate descends from the PR#52 / count-affine-plain line (blueberryvertigo, the WIP PR with documented sorries at 0.8748436 that 0136/0146 correctly judged non-adoptable as a RECORD) — but its Bernstein machinery inherited into PR#69 is now fully verified by our 0148 replay. The tool class (AI-assisted positive-expansion search + Lean assembly) is the dominant engine on the race.

## Next forward line (declared, started)

Aim the race's winning tool class directly at the IN-TREE face (item 1's small-d0 edge / item 3's worst point): extract the exact polynomial comparison kernel at the measured worst point (t = 1000, d0 = 1/200; ratio devProg/(p8_B + MrLift) >= 1.1136) and search for a POSITIVE BERNSTEIN expansion of the margin on a box. Success would close part of the face IN BODY — beyond the conveyor's reach (the conveyor only moves the d0 edge; a Bernstein closure could move the t-edge or the ratio itself). Failure (no expansion in the polynomial class) is itself a verdict: the face is not polynomial-closable at that point and needs a new analytic input class. Unit 0150 will carry the result. No in-tree change this unit; no RH claim anywhere.
